SELECT s.id, ROUND(COALESCE(m.activePower, ivt.activePower, v.activePower) / 1000, 2) AS activePower, ROUND(IFNULL(s.ac_capacity / 1000, 0), 2) AS capacity, ROUND(IFNULL(s.dc_capacity / 1000, 0), 2) AS dc_capacity FROM site s LEFT JOIN () v ON v.id_site = s.id LEFT JOIN () ivt ON ivt.id_site = s.id LEFT JOIN () m ON m.id_site = s.id
#{item}

SELECT s.id AS site_id, available.available_inverters, total.total_inverters, ROUND((available.available_inverters / total.total_inverters) * 100, 2) AS availability_percent, (total.total_inverters - available.available_inverters) as unavailable_inverters, AS site_name FROM site s
WHERE s.id = #{id_site}
mapper.sql:
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.id_site, COUNT(*) AS total_inverters FROM device d WHERE d.`status` = 1 AND d.is_delete = 0 AND d.id_device_type = 1
GROUP BY d.id_site ) AS total ON total.id_site = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.id_site, COUNT(*) AS available_inverters FROM device d WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.is_delete = 0 AND d.id_device_type = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alert a JOIN error e ON e.id = a.id_error WHERE a.id_device = d.id AND a.status = 1 AND a.resolved = 0 AND a.end_date is null AND (e.id_error_level = 32 OR e.id_error_level = 33) ) GROUP BY d.id_site ) available ON available.id_site = s.id
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.name AS site_name, c.name AS country, ROUND(IFNULL(s.ac_capacity / 1000, 0), 2) AS ac_capacity, ROUND(IFNULL(s.dc_capacity / 1000, 0), 2) AS dc_capacity, COUNT(a.id) AS total_count, IFNULL(SUM(el.id IN (32)), 0) AS critical_count, IFNULL(SUM(el.id IN (12, 33)), 0) AS warning_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 2 THEN d.id END) AS info_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 11 THEN d.id END) AS fatal_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 12 THEN d.id END) AS error_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 13 THEN d.id END) AS warning_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 14 THEN d.id END) AS debug_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 32 THEN d.id END) AS no_production_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 33 THEN d.id END) AS no_comm_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 36 THEN d.id END) AS power_factor_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 37 THEN d.id END) AS grid_frequency_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 38 THEN d.id END) AS zone_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 39 THEN d.id END) AS breaker_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 40 THEN d.id END) AS hvac_alert_device_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN el.id = 48 THEN d.id END) AS custom_alert_device_count
FROM site s LEFT JOIN country c ON c.id = s.id_country LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_site = s.id LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.id_device = d.id AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.end_date IS NULL LEFT JOIN error e ON e.id = a.id_error LEFT JOIN error_level el ON el.id = e.id_error_level WHERE s.is_delete = 0 AND s.status = 1
AND s.id = #{id}
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, c.name, s.ac_capacity, s.dc_capacity

SELECT s.id AS id_site, d.id_device_type, ROUND(AVG(d.last_value), 2) AS irradiance,
AS expected_power FROM site s LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_site = s.id WHERE d.id_device_type = 4 AND d.reverse_poa = 0 AND s.`status` = 1 AND s.is_delete = 0 AND d.`status` = 1 AND d.is_delete = 0
GROUP BY s.id

CASE s.pv_model WHEN 1 THEN IF( IFNULL(s.dc_capacity * (${irradiance} / s.global_solar_irradiance_at_stc) * (1 - (IFNULL(s.pv_module_temperature_coeff, -0.43)/100) * (s.stc_temperature - ${temperature})) * (1 - IFNULL(s.system_loss, 9)/100) * IFNULL(s.inverter_efficiency, 96)/100, 0) < s.ac_capacity, s.dc_capacity * (${irradiance} / s.global_solar_irradiance_at_stc) * (1 - (IFNULL(s.pv_module_temperature_coeff, -0.43)/100) * (s.stc_temperature - ${temperature})) * (1 - IFNULL(s.system_loss, 9)/100) * IFNULL(s.inverter_efficiency, 96)/100, s.ac_capacity ) WHEN 2 THEN IFNULL(s.dc_capacity * (${irradiance} / s.global_solar_irradiance_at_stc) * (1 - (1 + (IFNULL(s.pv_module_temperature_coeff, -0.43)/100)) * ((IF(IFNULL(${panelTemperature}, 0) > 0, ${panelTemperature}, IFNULL(${temperature}, 0)) - s.stc_temperature)/100)) * (POW(1 - (IFNULL(s.annual_pv_module_degradation, 0.5)/100), YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - IFNULL(YEAR(s.commissioning), YEAR(s.built_since)))) * (1 - (IFNULL(s.soiling, 5)/100)) * (1 - (IFNULL(s.cable_losses, 1)/100)) * (1 - (IFNULL(s.transformer_losses, 1.5)/100)) * (1 - (IFNULL(s.other_losses, 1.5)/100)) * (IFNULL(s.inverter_efficiency, 98.5)/100), 0) WHEN 3 THEN IF( (${irradiance} >= s.min_irradiance_limit) AND (IF(${power} > (s.ac_capacity * IFNULL(s.clip, 99)/100), 1, 0) = 0), s.dc_capacity * (${irradiance} / s.global_solar_irradiance_at_stc) * (1 - IFNULL(s.pv_module_temperature_coeff, -0.37)/100 * (s.t_avg - (${temperature} + ${irradiance}/s.global_solar_irradiance_at_stc * 3))) * IFNULL(s.inverter_efficiency, 100)/100, NULL ) ELSE NULL END
